# Verify Checkout Flow

- App: http://localhost:3000

> Why: Checkout is 80% of revenue. Broken checkout = lost orders.

1. Navigate to the product page
2. Click "Add to Cart" button
3. Verify the cart icon shows 1 item
4. Click the cart icon to open cart
5. Verify the product appears in the cart with correct price
6. Click "Proceed to Checkout"
7. See the payment form with shipping fields
